overall_assessment: Section extraction is poor for hivolda. The plan's fixed boilerplate blocks (metadata header, Sensorordning, Evaluering, Maksimumstal, Emneansvarleg, Vurderingsform table, Godkjent av) are swallowed by neighbouring sections, and the 'Generell kompetanse' learning-outcome group is regularly split off into the wrong section.

findings.evidence:
Pensum:
Pensumliste for emnet finn du her
Forkunnskapskrav, emneliste
MGL5-10NO1A Norsk 1A: Norsk på mellomsteget
findings.description: The 'Pensum:' label in the metadata header is taken as a reading_list heading. The whole header (Emnekode, Varighet, Studiepoeng, language), the prerequisite course list and the 'Om emnet' course description are filed as reading_list. The reading list itself is only a link text. Prerequisites and course_content are not extracted as sections at all.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R maps 'Pensum' to reading_list and matches the header block; 'Forkunnskapskrav, emneliste' and 'Om emnet' are not recognised or are appended to the previous section (no section boundary).
findings.suggested_fix: Add patterns mapping 'Om emnet' to course_content and 'Forkunnskapskrav...' to prerequisites in R/section_heading_map.R. Treat 'Pensum:' in the header as a metadata line (skip the header block up to 'Om emnet') with a hivolda-specific pre-clean in .clean_sections().

findings.description: Sub-headings of learning outcomes (Kunnskapar / Ferdigheiter / Generell kompetanse) act as boundaries in some courses: learning_outcomes ends at the 'Generell kompetanse' heading with the list empty. The Generell kompetanse bullets and the following 'Praktisk organisering og arbeidsmåtar' text then land in assessment (or course_content), and teaching_methods is merged into it. Learning outcomes are cut short, and the general-competence items are filed as assessment.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Generell kompetanse' (or a similar heading) is matched to an unrelated section or the strategy splits on it. 'Praktisk organisering og arbeidsmåtar' is not mapped to teaching_methods, so it is appended to the previous section.
findings.suggested_fix: In R/section_heading_map.R, map 'Kunnskap(ar)', 'Ferdigheit(er)' and 'Generell kompetanse' to learning_outcomes (sub-headings, never boundaries), and map 'Praktisk organisering og arbeidsmåtar' to teaching_methods. Check first-match ordering.

findings.evidence:
Praktisk organisering og arbeidsmåtar
Undervisingsformene vekslar mellom plenumsforelesing
findings.description: 'Praktisk organisering og arbeidsmåtar' is present in the plan but no teaching_methods row is emitted in most courses. The text sits inside assessment (course 1) or course_content (courses 3, 4) instead. Random controls 21-23 have teaching_methods correctly, so it is a heading-pattern problem that depends on plan variant.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading text 'Praktisk organisering og arbeidsmåtar' does not match any teaching_methods pattern in R/section_heading_map.R, while 'Undervisingsformer'-style headings in other plans do.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Praktisk organisering( og arbeidsmåtar)?' to the teaching_methods patterns in R/section_heading_map.R.

findings.evidence:
Sensorordning
Sensur vert gjennomført i samsvar med Forskrift om opptak, studium og eksamen ved Høgskulen i Volda, § 5-11 
Evaluering og kvalitetssikring
findings.description: coursework_requirements (from 'Vilkår for å framstille seg til eksamen') runs to the end of the page. It includes Sensorordning, Evaluering og kvalitetssikring, Minimumstal/Maksimumstal, Emneansvarleg (a person name, PII), the 'Emnet inngår i følgande studieprogram' line, the Vurderingsform exam table and 'Godkjent av' with a name. The real assessment (exam form) is therefore never an assessment section, and boilerplate and personal data pollute the section.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Sensorordning', 'Evaluering og kvalitetssikring' and 'Vurderingsform' are not recognised as headings or as section-ending or ignorable blocks, so text after the last mapped heading is appended to it.
findings.suggested_fix: In R/extract_sections.R (.clean_sections) or the heading map, treat 'Sensorordning', 'Evaluering og kvalitetssikring', 'Minimumstal', 'Maksimumstal', 'Emneansvarleg', 'Emnet inngår i følgande studieprogram' and 'Godkjent av' as terminators or drop them. Map the 'Vurderingsform Gruppering Varighet ...' table to assessment.

findings.evidence: Vurderingsform Gruppering Varighet Karakterskala Andel Kommentar Hjelpemidler Omfang Heimeeksamen Individuell 5 Dagar
findings.description: The exam description (Vurderingsform table: form, duration, grade scale, aids) is the actual assessment content, but it is emitted inside coursework_requirements (or reading_list) instead. Many courses have no assessment row at all. In other courses the assessment row holds non-assessment text (general competence outcomes, the metadata header).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Vurderingsform table has no heading and follows the studieprogram line, so it inherits the previous section.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a hivolda rule starting a new assessment section at a line beginning with 'Vurderingsform Gruppering'. Also split out the arbeidskrav block as coursework_requirements only.

findings.evidence: e. eit refleksjonsnotat. Notatet skal knytast til studentens observasjonar av lærarrolla frå eigen praksis og innehalde refleksjonar over desse
findings.description: Arbeidskrav (items e, f) are filed under assessment while items a-c are in coursework_requirements, so one list is split. The assessment row also carries Sensorordning, Evaluering, Maksimumstal, Emneansvarleg and the Vurderingsform table. In EN3C (courses 6, 11-14) the assessment row is instead the metadata header plus 'Om emnet', holding no assessment content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Numbered/lettered list items are split across headings, and the header/'Om emnet' block is mapped to assessment for EN3C.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the whole 'Vilkår for å framstille seg til eksamen' block together as coursework_requirements up to 'Sensorordning'. Fix the EN3C header mapping as in the reading_list finding.

findings.description: Teaching-format text is filed as course_content instead of teaching_methods. In the SA2B courses, the reading_list row holds arbeidskrav text, Sensorordning and the exam table instead of a reading list. In SP1 courses, course_content is the remainder of learning outcomes (from the knowledge bullets on) plus teaching methods, while learning_outcomes holds only the intro sentence.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Missing heading patterns in R/section_heading_map.R cause sections to be assigned to a neighbouring section or a wrong canonical section. The 'Kunnskapar' heading followed by a 'Studentane skal ha kunnskap om:' line is treated as course content.
findings.suggested_fix: Map 'Studentane skal ha/kunne...' and the 'Kunnskapar' sub-heading to learning_outcomes. Review the SA2B heading variants and map them to teaching_methods and coursework_requirements.
